rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when the person's identity or name is deliberately hidden.

example.english: I want to make an anonymous complaint.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 nik1 ming4 tau4 sou3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a letter, pamphlet, or other work that carries no identifying signature.

example.english: This pamphlet is anonymous, so I don't know who printed it.
example.traditional: 呢份傳單冇署名，唔知邊個印嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 cyun4 daan1 mou5 syu6 ming4 m4 zi1 bin1 go3 jan3 ge3
